Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD, etc.).
Solid experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Kubernetes in production.
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, Go).
Knowledge of security best practices, secrets management, IAM, networking, and compliance frameworks.
Comfortable working cross‑functionally with developers, product, and management to turn business needs into reliable infrastructure.

Experience supporting AI/ML workloads (GPU clusters, model serving, vector DBs), familiarity with KSA compliance standards (SDAIA, NCA ECC, PDPL), service mesh (Istio, Linkerd), and Fin Ops practices.

Joining Preference: Immediate joiners preferred

An urgent hiring opportunity is available for an experienced DevOps Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position is offered on a 12-month extendable contract, with the potential for a longer-term engagement.

The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience working in cloud environments, with strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipelines, GitLab, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Ansible automation, and Kubernetes cluster management.

Applicants should also understand cloud networking, containerization, microservices architecture, service discovery, and monitoring solutions. Arabic-speaking candidates who can join immediately are preferred.

• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.

• Manage cloud infrastructure across GCP and OCI environments.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Use Ansible for automation, including Kubernetes package management.

• Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, particularly Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

• Work with Nacos for service registry and configuration management.

• Support cloud networking, containerization, and microservices-based environments.

• Monitor cloud infrastructure and applications using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Google Cloud Operations Suite.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and contribute to reliable cloud operations.

• Collaborate with technical teams to improve automation, deployment processes, and infrastructure reliability.

Mandatory Technical Skills

• 5-10 years of relevant professional experience.

• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer in cloud environments, preferably GCP and OCI.

• Strong knowledge of GitLab, CI/CD, Terraform, and IaC practices.

• Proficiency in Ansible automation.

• Experience managing and troubleshooting Kubernetes, particularly GKE.

• Familiarity with Nacos for service registry and configuration.

• Solid understanding of cloud networking, containerization, and microservices architecture.

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• GCP professional certifications, such as GCP Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or GCP Professional Cloud Architect.

• Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, or Google Cloud Operations Suite.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Candidate Eligibility

• Arabic speakers only.

• Immediate joiners preferred.

• Candidates should have the required cloud engineering and DevOps experience.

Contract Details

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Duration: 12 months, extendable, with a potential long-term opportunity.

Salary, benefits, working arrangements, and visa or relocation provisions have not been specified in the supplied announcement. Candidates should confirm these details with the recruiter.

Position Summary

Laith IT Solutions is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to support enterprise software development and digital transformation initiatives. This role is ideal for a DevOps professional with strong expertise in GitHub, repository migration, CI/CD automation, and modern software delivery practices who can drive development efficiency and operational excellence.
Detailed

As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in modernizing development workflows, supporting application delivery pipelines, and implementing DevOps best practices across multiple projects. A major focus of this role will be leading Bitbucket-to-GitHub migration initiatives while ensuring minimal disruption to development teams and business operations. You will work closely with software developers, architects, QA engineers, and project stakeholders to streamline development processes, improve deployment reliability, and enhance software quality. The successful candidate will possess strong experience in source code management, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and custom product development environments. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to high-impact technology projects within a fast-growing and innovative organization.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead and execute Bitbucket to GitHub migration projects, including repository assessment, planning, migration, validation, and post-migration support.
• Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support automated software delivery.
• Manage GitHub repositories, branching strategies, workflows, permissions, and governance policies.
• Collaborate with development teams to improve application deployment processes and release management practices.
• Support custom product development initiatives through DevOps tooling and automation.
• Implement version control best practices across software development teams.
• Automate build, testing, deployment, and monitoring processes to improve operational efficiency.
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, testing, and production environments.
• Ensure security, compliance, and governance requirements are incorporated into DevOps workflows.
• Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and infrastructure configurations.
• Promote DevOps culture and best practices across engineering teams.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on scalability, reliability, and performance.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience working as a DevOps Engineer within enterprise or product development environments.
• Strong hands-on experience with GitHub administration and repository management.
• Demonstrated experience executing Bitbucket to GitHub migration projects.
• Experience supporting custom software product development and engineering teams.
• Strong knowledge of CI/CD concepts, tools, and deployment automation.
• Expertise in source code management, version control workflows, and branching strategies.
• Experience implementing DevOps best practices across development lifecycles.
• Strong understanding of software development methodologies and release management processes.
• Experience troubleshooting build, deployment, and environment-related issues.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with GitHub Actions for workflow and deployment automation.
• Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application environments.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools).
• Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and secure software delivery pipelines.
• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
Recruitment Pro Tip

For DevOps positions, employers want evidence of automation and measurable impact. Highlight specific CI/CD pipelines you built, migration projects you completed, deployment time reductions achieved, infrastructure automation initiatives delivered, and improvements in software release frequency, reliability, or operational efficiency. Quantifiable results will significantly strengthen your application.
